title: Heterometallic Zn3Ln3 Ensembles Containing (μ6-CO3) Ligand and Triangular Disposition of Ln3+ ions: Analysis of Single-Molecule Toroic (SMT) and Single-Molecule Magnet (SMM) Behavior

synthesis.procedure: General protocol for hexanuclear complexes 2–3: a methanolic solution (5 mL) of Ln(NO3)3·nH2O (3 equiv.) was added dropwise under stirring to a 20 mL methanolic solution of LH2 (1) (2 equiv.) and triethylamine (4 equiv.). Solid Zn(ClO4)2·6H2O (3 equiv.) was added and the mixture was stirred for 1.5 h, then stirred for a further 12 h. The solvent was removed under vacuum; the white solid was washed with diethyl ether (3 × 5 mL), redissolved in methanol, and filtered. The filtrate was crystallized by slow evaporation at room temperature; colorless block crystals suitable for X-ray analysis were isolated after 15 days. Atmospheric CO2 is incorporated as μ6-CO3 in basic medium. Quantities for 2: Zn(ClO4)2·6H2O (0.062 g, 0.169 mmol), Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.074 g, 0.169 mmol), LH2 (0.044 g, 0.113 mmol), and Et3N (0.024 g, 0.226 mmol).

properties.summary: Discrete Zn3Dy3 cluster is a single-molecule toroic (SMT) with nearly coplanar, tangential Dy local moments and SMM behavior: χMT 41.4 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K falling to 16.4 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K; slow ac relaxation under zero and applied dc fields with Ueff = 48(1) K and τ0 = 1.0(1)×10−6 s from Arrhenius fitting of the high-T process at 2000 Oe; micro-SQUID hysteresis below ~3 K with an S-shaped zero-field step and a broad step near ±0.35 T. Solid-state Dy3+ emission is weakly sensitized (peaks including 476 and 574 nm); ligand fluorescence remains strong.

synthesis.procedure: Same general methanolic protocol as 2, substituting Tb(NO3)3·5H2O. Quantities: Zn(ClO4)2·6H2O (0.062 g, 0.169 mmol), Tb(NO3)3·5H2O (0.074 g, 0.170 mmol), LH2 (0.044 g, 0.113 mmol), Et3N (0.024 g, 0.226 mmol). Stir 1.5 h after Zn addition then 12 h; vacuum removal of solvent; Et2O wash; redissolve in MeOH; slow evaporation at RT for 15 days yields colorless blocks. Ambient CO2 is fixed as μ6-CO3.

properties.summary: Isostructural Zn3Tb3 cluster: χMT 34.3 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K and 16.5 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. No SMM behavior above 2 K (degeneracy of the exchange-coupled ground state lifted at zero field, favoring QTM). Intense green Tb3+ luminescence in the solid state (λex = 360 nm) with characteristic 5D4→7FJ bands; in MeOH solution (λex = 310 nm) ligand fluorescence is quenched and Tb emission is more effectively sensitized.
